request: Build a canvas paint app in a single HTML file. It has pen and eraser tools with adjustable brush size, a color picker, a bucket fill tool that flood-fills a connected region, undo and redo stacks limited to 30 steps with keyboard shortcuts, PNG export as a download, localStorage autosave on every stroke, and a clear button.

intent.goal: build a canvas paint app in a single html file.

planFiles.summary: Canvas Paint HTML, CSS, and JavaScript in one file
